legs: Single continuous steadicam move, no cuts. The camera keeps gliding forward from the garden path onto the gravel terrace under the brick vaults and slows to a gentle glide along the long candlelit table at seated eye level, neighbors of all ages laughing and passing a bowl, a girl filling water glasses from a clay jug.

Single continuous steadicam move, no cuts. As dinner ends the camera drifts with the people down a short lantern lit path to the round stone fire circle and settles low beside the flames, blankets, a guitar, kids leaning in close.

Single continuous camera move, no cuts. Sparks lift from the fire and the camera tilts up and rises with them into a deep night sky full of stars and the Milky Way, the small warm lights of the village far below beside the dark lake.
